decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the core offer and still has its own page, so it costs little to carry, and two years of results are not yet enough to show it lacks value.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics depend on long contract and hospitality specification cycles, so their value is still resolving while holding them stays cheap.
The double-face wool blend has only a brief website mention, which signals limited traction, but it fits the renewable-materials direction and costs little to hold for another year.

The wool bouclé leno resembles the withdrawn bouclé fabric B and has low visibility, so it carries the highest risk, but its wool basis and low carrying cost justify keeping the option open a little longer.
The braided-structure fabric launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its uncertainty is still high and it should stay on the market until results arrive.
